title: Immune AMBER: monitor symptoms and labs
todo: Content drafted by the team, NOT medically reviewed. Must be reviewed by a flight surgeon / NASA HRP source before any real use. Add source_title/source_url when verified.

n1.text: Do you have a fever or chills?

n2.text: Limit close contact with crewmates, wear a mask if available, and clean shared surfaces you touch.

n3.text: Log symptoms every day and keep hydrated and rested.

n4.text: Enter your next onboard lab result when it is due.

end.text: If this stays AMBER for 3 more days, include it in your next summary for the flight surgeon.
